violation_type.title: Child Who Was Ill May Return to Care With Statement from Health-Care Professional That Child No Longer Ill (26 TAC §746.3606(2))
violation_type.short_title: Child Who Was Ill May Return to Care With Statement from Health-Care Professional That Child No Longer Ill
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the preponderance of evidence it was determined the operation allowed a child who exhibited symptoms of illness, return to care and the operation did not obtain a physician's note.

finding_variants.text: Based on the preponderance of evidence it was determined the operation allowed a child who exhibited symptoms of illness, return to care and the operation did not obtain a physician's note.
The operation received a doctor's note that stated a child could not be in care for three days.  Sign in and out logs showed the child was back in care after being absent for one day.
